# vendor/

Pinned fork of `damient/govee-toolkit` (§44-45): see `govee-toolkit/PIN.md`
for revision, license, seam, and H6076/H1A45 profile plan.

`@autolight/govee` frame codec (B0/B1/XOR) is independently implemented and
tested; the fork owns the live `SegmentStream` binding when hardware arrives.
